Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 404 'pass not found' when the id path segment is not a positive integer (non-numeric)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}

Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 404 'pass not found' when the id path segment is a positive integer greater than 2147483647 (out of Postgres integer range)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}

Description: Verify GET /passes/{id} returns 404 'pass not found' when the id is a valid positive integer within range but no passes row exists with that id
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}
